import os, re, shutil, tempfile, zipfile
from pathlib import Path

pptx = Path('/home/user/Desktop/45_1.pptx')
slide = 'ppt/slides/slide14.xml'

def replace_shape_size(xml, shape_name, text, size):
    pattern = re.compile(r'(<p:sp>.*?<p:cNvPr["'^>]*name="'"' + re.escape(shape_name) + r'\".*?</p:sp>)', re.S)
    m = pattern.search(xml)
    if not m:
        raise SystemExit(f'Missing shape {shape_name}')
    block = m.group(1)
    if text not in block:
        raise SystemExit(f'Shape {shape_name} did not contain expected text')
    new_block = re.sub(r'(<a:rPr\\b["'^>]*'"\\bsz=\")\\d+(\"["'^>]*>)'"', rf'\\g<1>{size}\\2', block)
    new_block = re.sub(r'(<a:endParaRPr\\b["'^>]*'"\\bsz=\")\\d+(\"["'^>]*>)'"', rf'\\g<1>{size}\\2', new_block)
    if new_block == block:
        raise SystemExit(f'No font size attribute updated for {shape_name}')
    return xml[:m.start(1)] + new_block + xml[m.end(1):]

with zipfile.ZipFile(pptx, 'r') as zin:
    xml = zin.read(slide).decode('utf-8')
    xml = replace_shape_size(xml, 'Google Shape;306;p26', 'Target audience', 6000)
    xml = replace_shape_size(xml, 'Google Shape;307;p26', 'Elaborate on what you want to discuss.', 2800)

    fd, tmp_name = tempfile.mkstemp(suffix='.pptx', dir=str(pptx.parent))
    os.close(fd)
    tmp = Path(tmp_name)

        with zipfile.ZipFile(tmp, 'w') as zout:
            for item in zin.infolist():
                data = zin.read(item.filename)
                if item.filename == slide:
                    data = xml.encode('utf-8')
                zout.writestr(item, data)
        shutil.copystat(pptx, tmp)
        os.replace(tmp, pptx)
    finally:
        if tmp.exists():
            tmp.unlink()
print('updated')
